verdict.rationale: Mercury Books does provide continuous automatic reconciliation/categorization and an AI assistant (Command) that can be handed bookkeeping tasks in plain language, which covers part of the 'agent reconciles the month' story. However, the MCP layer that would let an external AI agent 'handle bookkeeping tasks end-to-end' is explicitly described as forthcoming ('Soon...an MCP layer will let AI agents handle bookkeeping tasks end-to-end'), not yet shipped, and Mercury itself cautions that automation is a 'starting point' not 'autopilot,' implying human judgment/exception handling still required rather than an agent doing full month-end close prep. Missing for 10: a shipped agent/API interface for autonomous end-to-end reconciliation, explicit exception-flagging workflow for agents, and evidence of an agent (not just Command chat) preparing a close package for human review.
